name: Tarka dal
steps: Simmer the cooked lentils with a little water until soft and creamy.
In a separate pan, fry the onion in ghee until golden.
Add the garlic, turmeric, cumin and chilli powder and sizzle briefly.
Stir in the tomatoes and cook to a thick base.
Pour the spiced tarka into the lentils and stir through.
Simmer a few minutes, season, and serve.
